items.question: Why are you interested in Cloudflare's Software Engineering Internship? What products or features are you interested in building?
items.problem:
Expected "Most of what I build ends up being about safety boundaries in automated systems, which is why Cloudflare's position in front of millions of Internet properties interests me. I built a Playwright-based job-application agent in TypeScript where every application moves through an explicit state machine, every mutating capability sits behind fail-closed environment flags like SUBMIT_ENABLED that never default on, and free-text and demographic fields are architecturally prevented from being auto-filled. I also built a validation ladder (unit, fixture, live read-only, live mutation) because a capability passing against a local fixture does not mean it works against reality. That mindset seems relevant to infrastructure where a bad deploy is visible to a large fraction of the web.

The products I would most want to work on are the developer platform and anything sitting between automated agents and the open Internet. I have also built an anomaly-detection and alert-prioritization system with temporal sequence modeling over event streams plus a learning-to-rank layer, since an anomaly system producing too many alerts creates a second problem. Traffic anomaly detection and abuse signals at network scale are the same problem with much more data."; page shows "Undergrad"
